name: Swinging Logs Trap (CR 7)
body:
Swinging Logs Trap
CR 7 (XP 3,200)

STATISTICS

Type mechanical; Notice Perception DC 25; Remove Disable Device DC 20; Trigger location; Reset manual

EFFECTS

Attack +12 melee (6d4 bludgeoning and 6d4 nonlethal); multiple targets (all targets within 10 feet of the tripwire’s trigger)
